name: Lahemaa National Park
description: An hour east of Tallinn and immediately empty: four peninsulas of pine forest running into the Baltic, bog boardwalks, glacial boulders the size of vans, and three restored manor houses. Käsmu was a smugglers' village and looks it.
getting: Buses from Tallinn to Võsu take about 90 minutes but leave you stranded between trailheads. Hire a car for the day — the loop is easy driving.
